ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm / TA450) RMM-tool install via phishing lure
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's signature initial-access chain: spearphish PDF/HTML smuggling lure → user clicks → installs a legitimate remote-monitoring tool (Atera, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, SimpleHelp). The RMM is then used as their persistent C2/hands-on-keyboard channel before deploying PowerShell tooling. CrowdStrike tracks this as Static Kitten; Microsoft as Mango Sandstorm/MERCURY; Proofpoint as TA450.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","msiexec.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","SimpleHelp.exe","RemoteUtilitiesViewer.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*AteraAgent.msi*","*setup-AteraAgent*","*ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup*","*Remote Utilities*","*Syncro.Installer*","*SimpleHelpCustomerSetup*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let RmmAgents = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.service.exe","simplehelp.exe","remoteutilitiesviewer.exe"]);
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["AteraAgent.msi","setup-AteraAgent","ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup","Remote Utilities","RUT_","Syncro.Installer","SimpleHelpCustomerSetup","AnyDesk.exe /S"]);
let SuspParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","wscript.exe","mshta.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName in~ (RmmAgents))
   or (ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmInstallers))
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspParents)
   or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (SuspParents)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\Program Files\Atera Networks\"
    and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\Program Files (x86)\ScreenConnect Client\"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Grandparent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RmmAgents = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.service.exe","simplehelp.exe","remoteutilitiesviewer.exe"]);
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["AteraAgent.msi","setup-AteraAgent","ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup","Remote Utilities","Syncro.Installer","SimpleHelpCustomerSetup"]);
let SuspParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","wscript.exe","mshta.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend NewProc    = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| extend ParentProc = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where (NewProc in (RmmAgents)) or (CommandLine has_any (RmmInstallers))
| where ParentProc in (SuspParents)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: MuddyWater RMM Tool Install Spawned From Phishing Surface
id: a1f2c3d4-5b6e-4a7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects installation/execution of remote-monitoring tools (Atera, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, SimpleHelp) spawned from email clients, browsers, or archive utilities — the trademark initial-access chain attributed to MuddyWater (a.k.a. Mango Sandstorm / MERCURY / Static Kitten / TA450).
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/04/07/mercury-and-dev-1084-destructive-attack-on-hybrid-environment/
  - https://www.proofpoint.com/us/blog/threat-insight/ta450-uses-embedded-links-pdf-attachments-latest-campaign
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1219.002

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\rfusclient.exe'
      - '\Syncro.Service.exe'

      - '\RemoteUtilitiesViewer.exe'

      - 'setup-AteraAgent'

fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned helpdesk deployment of RMM via centrally pushed installer (allow-list installer path / signing account)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MSEDGE.EXE OR *\chrome.exe OR *\CHROME.EXE OR *\firefox.exe OR *\FIREFOX.EXE OR *\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\MSIEXEC.EXE OR *\explorer.exe OR *\EXPLORER.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe) AND (@Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\ATERAAGENT.EXE OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\RUTSERV.EXE OR *\rfusclient.exe OR *\Syncro.Service.exe OR *\SimpleHelp.exe OR *\RemoteUtilitiesViewer.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*AteraAgent.msi* OR *setup-AteraAgent* OR *ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup* OR *"Remote Utilities"* OR *Syncro.Installer* OR *SimpleHelpCustomerSetup*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(outlook|msedge|chrome|firefox|winrar|7zg|explorer|msiexec|wscript|mshta)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(ateraagent|screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro\.service|simplehelp|remoteutilitiesviewer)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(AteraAgent\.msi|setup-AteraAgent|ConnectWiseControl\.ClientSetup|Remote Utilities|Syncro\.Installer|SimpleHelpCustomerSetup)/i
| NOT (ParentImageFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\(Atera Networks|ScreenConnect Client|VMware)\\/i)

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater POWGOOP DLL side-loading via signed Google/VMware binaries
ucs.description: Hunts the POWGOOP loader chain: MuddyWater drops a legitimate signed binary (goopdate.exe / GoogleUpdate.exe / vmnat.exe) plus a malicious sibling DLL (goopdate.dll, vmtools.dll) into an attacker-controlled directory. The legit binary side-loads the DLL, which decrypts an encoded PowerShell stager (logo.png / config.txt) and spawns powershell.exe for hands-on activity. This loader is publicly attributed to MuddyWater (a.k.a. Seedworm / Static Kitten) by Deep Instinct and ClearSky.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("goopdate.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","vmnat.exe","cliconfg.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT (parent_process_path IN ("*\\Program Files\\Google\\*","*\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\*","*\\Program Files\\VMware\\*","*\\Program Files (x86)\\VMware\\*","*\\Windows\\System32\\*")) | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LegitLoaders = dynamic(["goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","vmnat.exe","cliconfg.exe"]);
let SideloadDlls = dynamic(["goopdate.dll","goopdate86.dll","vmtools.dll","cliconfg.dll"]);
let TrustedDirs = dynamic([@"\program files\google\",@"\program files (x86)\google\",@"\program files\vmware\",@"\program files (x86)\vmware\",@"\windows\system32\"]);
let Loads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (SideloadDlls)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LegitLoaders)
    | extend LoaderDirLower = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
    | where not(LoaderDirLower has_any (TrustedDirs))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SideloadedDll = FileName, DllFolder = FolderPath,
              LoaderName    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              LoaderPath    = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              LoaderPid     = InitiatingProcessId;
Loads
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LegitLoaders)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              ChildName = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SpawnLoaderPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              SpawnLoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              AccountName
) on DeviceId
| where SpawnTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| where SpawnLoaderPid == LoaderPid
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project LoadTime = Timestamp, SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SideloadedDll, DllFolder, LoaderName, LoaderPath,
          ChildName, ChildCmd
| order by LoadTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LegitLoaders = dynamic(["goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe","vmnat.exe","cliconfg.exe"]);
let TrustedDirs = dynamic([@"\program files\google\",@"\program files (x86)\google\",@"\program files\vmware\",@"\program files (x86)\vmware\",@"\windows\system32\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLower = tolower(ParentProcessName)
| extend NewLower    = tolower(NewProcessName)
| extend ParentName  = tostring(split(ParentLower, @"\")[-1])
| where ParentName in (LegitLoaders)
| where NewLower has_any (@"\powershell.exe",@"\pwsh.exe",@"\cmd.exe",@"\rundll32.exe")
| where not(ParentLower has_any (TrustedDirs))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater POWGOOP — Signed Loader Spawning Script Interpreter From Non-Standard Path
id: b2e3c4f5-6c7d-4b8a-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater's POWGOOP DLL side-loading chain — a legitimately signed Google/VMware binary (goopdate.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe, vmnat.exe) running from a non-Program-Files directory and immediately spawning powershell.exe / cmd.exe / rundll32.exe. The malicious sibling DLL decrypts an encoded PowerShell stager.
references:
  - https://www.deepinstinct.com/blog/new-muddywater-threat-old-kitten-new-tricks
  - https://www.clearskysec.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/MuddyWater-PowGoop.pdf
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0069
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\goopdate.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
      - '\vmnat.exe'
      - '\cliconfg.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  filter_trusted_paths:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\Program Files\Google\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\Google\'
      - '\Program Files\VMware\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\VMware\'
      - '\Windows\System32\'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and not filter_trusted_paths
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate vendor installers staging from a temp directory (verify signing chain + file age)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\goopdate.exe OR *\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\GOOGLEUPDATE.EXE OR *\vmnat.exe OR *\VMNAT.EXE OR *\cliconfg.exe OR *\CLICONFG.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE) -@ParentImage:(*\Program\ Files\Google\* OR *\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\Google\* OR *\Program\ Files\VMware\* OR *\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\VMware\* OR *\Windows\System32\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(goopdate|googleupdate|vmnat|cliconfg)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|rundll32)\.exe$/i
| NOT (ParentImageFileName=/\\(Program Files( \(x86\))?)\\(Google|VMware)\\/i OR ParentImageFileName=/\\Windows\\System32\\/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: POWGOOP is publicly and exclusively attributed to MuddyWater by Deep Instinct, ClearSky, and Cisco Talos. The diagnostic signal is geometric: a legitimately-signed Google/VMware binary loading its sibling DLL from a directory under user-writeable paths (Downloads, Public, ProgramData), then immediately spawning PowerShell. Generic side-loading hunts miss this — the binary-set + the post-load scrip
